name: Sidekick (Variant Leadership)
body:
You recruit a follower who, like you, has a masked persona.

Prerequisite(s): character level 4th, dual identity class feature or masked persona.

Benefit(s): This feat is similar to the Leadership feat, with several exceptions. You can attract only a 1st-level cohort (referred to hereafter as a sidekick) with this feat, and can’t recruit followers. You determine your Leadership score according to the rules presented in the Leadership feat, but your sidekick is always at least 3 levels lower than yourself.

A sidekick can take levels in only fighter, rogue, or vigilante. They cannot multiclass, though they can take any archetype for which they qualify.

Your sidekick gains a masked persona and gains all of the benefits of your own dual identity or masked persona feature. If your sidekick is accompanying you, changing identities for them requires the same amount of time that it takes for you, regardless of how much time it would normally take them. Your sidekick can never be coerced to reveal your true identity.

If a sidekick gains enough XP to bring them to 2 levels lower than your level, they don’t gain the new level until you gain your next level; until you advance, their XP total remains 1 less than the amount needed to attain the next level.

If you release your sidekick from service or otherwise lose your sidekick, you can recruit a new one. At 7th level, you can swap this feat for the Leadership feat.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
